context_requirements: No known transcriptional output program for calpain inhibition in these cell lines
Calpain substrates are primarily cytoskeletal and signaling proteins, not transcription factors
Any effect would require specific calpain-dependent transcriptional regulation not established in this context
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of stress or apoptosis genes at 6 or 24 h
Consistent changes in CAPN1 or calpain-pathway landmark genes
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines
